gloss: to underestimate; to look down on; to make light of

definitions.gloss: to underestimate; to look down on; to make light of
definitions.explanation: to judge someone or something as less capable or important than they actually are

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびるな。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you underestimate this problem, it will turn into a serious matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびらないでほしい。
examples.english: I don't want you to look down on me.

notes:
A godan verb meaning to underestimate or belittle someone. Carries a stronger emotional charge than ⟦{甘|あま}く{見|み}る→甘く見る：15637_amakumiru⟧, implying contempt or dismissiveness toward the other person's capabilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびる: to underestimate one's opponent
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}くびる: to underestimate someone's ability
- {見|み}くびって⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない: must not underestimate
- {見|み}くびられる: to be looked down on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{甘|あま}く{見|み}る→甘く見る：15637_amakumiru⟧: to take lightly or underestimate; less confrontational and more commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦{侮|あなど}る→侮る：10884_anadoru⟧: to despise or hold in contempt; more literary and carries a stronger sense of scorn
- ⟦{舐|な}める→舐める：04399_nameru⟧: (colloquial) to look down on or not take seriously; slangy and blunt

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (looking) + くびる (an archaic verb meaning to count or reckon low), literally meaning to regard as being of low value.
